set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== STEP 1: write inventory-api app =="
sudo -n install -d -m0755 /opt/inventory-api
sudo -n tee /opt/inventory-api/app.py > /dev/null <<'PYEOF'
import BaseHTTPServer
import json
import time

START = time.time()
INVENTORY = {"widgets": 120, "gadgets": 45, "sprockets": 300}

class Handler(BaseHTTPServer.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path == "/health":
            body = json.dumps({"status": "ok", "uptime_s": round(time.time() - START, 1)})
        else:
            body = json.dumps({"inventory": INVENTORY, "uptime_s": round(time.time() - START, 1)})
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        pass

def main():
    server = BaseHTTPServer.HTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", 8080), Handler)
    server.serve_forever()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
PYEOF
echo "== STEP 2: write inventory-api systemd unit (OOM-protected) =="
sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/system/inventory-api.service > /dev/null <<'UNITEOF'
[Unit]
Description=Inventory API
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python2 /opt/inventory-api/app.py
Restart=always
RestartSec=1
OOMScoreAdjust=-1000
Slice=inventory-api.slice

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
UNITEOF
echo "== STEP 3: write memory-hog app =="
sudo -n install -d -m0755 /opt/memory-hog
sudo -n tee /opt/memory-hog/hog.py > /dev/null <<'PYEOF'
import time

def main():
    chunks = []
    chunk_size = 20 * 1024 * 1024  # 20MB
    while True:
        b = bytearray(chunk_size)
        for i in range(0, chunk_size, 4096):
            b[i] = 1
        chunks.append(b)
        time.sleep(0.1)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
PYEOF
echo "== STEP 4: write memory-hog systemd unit (default OOM score, no auto-restart) =="
sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/system/memory-hog.service > /dev/null <<'UNITEOF'
[Unit]
Description=Memory Hog (test load, deliberately unbounded)
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python2 /opt/memory-hog/hog.py
Restart=no
OOMScoreAdjust=900

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
UNITEOF
echo "== STEP 5: reload systemd, enable+start inventory-api =="
sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload
sudo -n systemctl enable inventory-api.service
sudo -n systemctl start inventory-api.service
sleep 1
sudo -n systemctl is-active inventory-api.service
echo "== STEP 6: firewall allow 8080 (for completeness) =="
sudo -n firewall-cmd --add-port=8080/tcp 2>/dev/null || true
echo "== STEP 7: verify serving via NODE_IP =="
curl -s -m 5 "http://$NODE_IP:8080/health"
echo
curl -s -m 5 "http://$NODE_IP:8080/"
echo
echo "== DONE =="
